newsitem.title: USA: Integrated Circuit says Q3 shr loss $0.88.
newsitem.headline: Integrated Circuit says Q3 shr loss $0.88.

text.p: (in thousands, except for per share data)
Three Months Ended Nine Months Ended

Note: The company said the earnings per share from continuing operations excludes a loss from minority interest in equity investment and the in-process R & D charge. The companmy said the earnings per share from continuing operations showed a 21 percent gain over that reported for the preceding quarter.

The company said it made the decision during the quarter to dispose of its majority interest in a subsidiary, Ark Logic. The company said the decision resulted in a charge of $2.89 million for discontinued operations.
The company said its financial statements have been restated to exclude Ark Logic's results from the continuing operations. Ark Logic's results are instead shown as discontinued operations.

The company said that after accounting for the one time charge for the discontinued operations of Ark Logic and the non-recurring write-off for in-process R & D at MicroClock, it showed a net loss of $10.8 million, or $0.88 per share, for the third fiscal quarter of 1997.
